lines.en: Bow in hand, I patrol the village edge
My steps are short but quick
I walk a full loop along the wall
My quiver sways behind my hip
I look up at something farther off
I hop between the rooftops
My eyes are bright at night
I follow the sand path to the village gate
I count heads as I walk
I circle around to the back of a house

lines.zh: 我从这个屋角走到那个屋角
lines.en: I walk from one house corner to the next

lines.zh: 我把弓背到身后，走得快些
lines.en: I sling the bow back and walk faster
I stand motionless on the watchtower
My hand rests on the bow

lines.zh: 我在听村子外面的声音
lines.en: I listen for sounds outside the village

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没离开地平线
lines.en: My eyes never leave the horizon
I crouch, ready to rise
The night wind is cold
I line the arrows up one by one

lines.zh: 我一动不动地守着这一面
lines.en: I guard this side without moving
I count the shadows in the distance
My breathing is shallow and steady
Whose household are you from
You have come too far inside

lines.zh: 我的弓已经拉开了半寸
lines.en: My bow is already drawn half an inch
You carry none of our marks
Halt, state your purpose
This post is mine to hold.

lines.zh: 别看我的手，看我的眼睛
lines.en: Do not watch my hand, watch my eyes

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势不像客人
lines.en: You do not walk like a guest
Try one more step forward
My arrow is faster than your step
You had best turn around now
I have your face in mind
I took one hard hit on the body
My shoulder guard took most of it
I fell back half a step, the bow still in hand
Blood comes through my fingers
I nock another arrow
This wound does not stop me drawing
I swallow the pain back
The village is still behind me
My feet can still hold me
I take a steadier stance
A guard takes no outsider's food

lines.zh: 你举着它想让我放下弓吗
lines.en: You hold that up hoping I lower my bow
The village provides enough

lines.zh: 我不接陌生人给的东西
lines.en: I do not take things from strangers

lines.zh: 你把它放在地上，然后退后
lines.en: Put it on the ground and step back
My quiver matters more than this
If your hand moves, I draw

lines.zh: 这东西在我眼里是破绽
lines.en: To me that thing is a weakness

lines.zh: 守卫吃的是自己的口粮
lines.en: A guard eats his own ration

lines.zh: 你收起来，我们还能说话
lines.en: Put it away and we can still talk
You hit my shoulder guard
Knocked back, my heel finds the ground first.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，弓还举着
lines.en: We collided, bow still up
You put real weight in that

lines.zh: 我一手撑住墙，一手举弓
lines.en: I brace on the wall with one hand, bow up with the other

lines.zh: 这一下没打断我的架式
lines.en: That did not break my stance
My quiver was knocked askew
I back off and re-open the distance
You have crossed my guard line
I dislike fighting in close
My duty is at the village gate
I have no time for such things
I must hold this stretch of wall

lines.zh: 我们这一支活下来不容易
lines.en: Our branch has not had it easy
That is not what you meant to ask
My bow never leaves my hand

lines.zh: 我摇了摇头，眼睛没离开外面
lines.en: I shake my head, eyes still on the outside

lines.zh: 守卫不适合有这些念头
lines.en: A guard is unfit for such thoughts
I straighten an arrow
I go back to watching outside
I bend down and pick up an arrow
This one can still fly

lines.zh: 我把掉在地上的都收好
lines.en: I gather everything that fell

lines.zh: 箭不够的时候我会自己削
lines.en: When arrows run short I whittle my own

lines.zh: 地上这块石子能当弹丸
lines.en: This pebble will serve as a slug.
This stone will do as well
I tuck it into the side pouch of my quiver.

lines.zh: 村子里的东西不能浪费
lines.en: Nothing in this village may be wasted
I watch outside while I gather
I counted them once
A shadow has appeared over there

lines.zh: 我已经看见了，你不用提醒
lines.en: I already saw it, no need to point
My arrow is on the string
At this distance I can be exact
It is coming toward the village

lines.zh: 我锁定了它的行走路线
lines.en: I have its path fixed
I do not call for help, I shoot first
The hand on my string is steady
I will predict its next step
A little closer and it is mine
Its shadow has crossed the village line
I draw the string to my cheek
It came from the east

lines.zh: 我的手在弦上停了一瞬
lines.en: My hand paused on the string
I move the sight with it
It walks in a clear pattern
I shifted half a step left

lines.zh: 箭尖对着它前进的方向
lines.en: My arrowhead points where it will be
I am counting its rhythm
It looked up, perfect
I hold my breath still in my chest.
The village is still asleep

lines.zh: 我不会让它走到那扇门前
lines.en: I will not let it reach that door
The string presses against my cheek.

lines.zh: 我在等它走到空地中央
lines.en: I wait for it to reach the open ground

lines.zh: 它换了一次方向，我也换了
lines.en: It changed direction, and so did I
My arrowhead follows the line of its chest

lines.zh: 这不是第一次，也不会是最后一次
lines.en: This is not the first, nor the last

lines.zh: 我算好了它下一步落点
lines.en: I have its next footfall worked out
I released the arrow
The arrow flies where it is heading
I step back and nock another
I knock it aside with my elbow
This arrow takes its shoulder
I shoot while retreating
I duck as it lunges

lines.zh: 我换成了近距离的打法
lines.en: I switch to close-range fighting
I shove it away and guard the doorway
My second arrow has already arrived
I pull an arrow and stab with it
I block it with the back of the bow
I push it away from the doorframe

lines.zh: 这一箭贴着地面射出去
lines.en: This arrow leaves low along the ground
I hold the bow left, push with the right
I retreat behind the wall and draw again
I take the post at the village gate
As long as the village stands, so do I
My bowstring is new

lines.zh: 我这一支是从远境留下来的
lines.en: My branch stayed on from the far land
I never close my eyes at night
I hang the quiver at my hip
The sand here is fine
I can see very far
My duty is simple
My quiver is packed full
I have moved to guard another wall
The string is already tuned

lines.zh: 火苗爬上我的护腕，很烫
lines.en: Flames climb my bracer and it burns.
I fell from the watchtower

lines.zh: 我呛了一口水，弓要滑了
lines.en: I choke on water and my bow is slipping.
The blast threw me away from the wall

lines.zh: 一支箭反插进我的手臂
lines.en: An arrow lodged in my arm

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的手指发麻
lines.en: That magic numbed my fingers

lines.zh: 我已经两班没吃东西了
lines.en: I have gone two shifts without food
Lightning struck my bow
The tower beneath me is gone
